title.zh: US seeks $61M in USDT allegedly tied to sanctioned Iranian oil sales
title.en: US seeks $61M in USDT allegedly tied to sanctioned Iranian oil sales

current_state.zh: The US Department of Justice is seeking forfeiture of over $61 million in USDT that Tether froze across 10 Tron addresses, alleging the funds are proceeds from sanctioned Iranian oil sales linked to the IRGC and moved through Binance accounts.
current_state.en: The US Department of Justice is seeking forfeiture of over $61 million in USDT that Tether froze across 10 Tron addresses, alleging the funds are proceeds from sanctioned Iranian oil sales linked to the IRGC and moved through Binance accounts.
